ModMetaData.name: Ronald Realist
ModMetaData.author: Pupique
ModMetaData.description:
A different type of RimWorld storyteller whose main premise is an event frequency revamp based on geographical, environmental, and colonial (wealth and population) factors.
An overall revamp of storytellers is not this mod's purpose and is not included in its scope.
Feel free to visit and even fork the repository: https://github.com/Pupique/RonaldRealist
Thanks!
